patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring artfully arranged product photography as the background, with text and CTA overlaid on a clear area.
Strategic use of a deep, rich red (#D42927) as a primary accent for CTAs and a full-width section background, contrasting with a clean white and dark grey palette.
Prominent use of a bold, condensed sans-serif for headings and uppercase labels, creating a strong, editorial feel, complemented by a readable, clean sans-serif for body text.
The hero section exhibits a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text and button, creating depth.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections with alternating background colors (white, red, dark grey) to clearly delineate different content blocks.

technique_notes: To achieve the hero effect, a large background image is set to cover the viewport, and its position is adjusted at a slower rate than the scroll speed, while foreground text and buttons scroll normally over it.
The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport using a sticky positioning technique, ensuring it remains accessible throughout the user's scroll journey.
Content sections are built as full-width blocks, with varying background colors applied to provide visual separation and guide the user's eye through the page's narrative.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, and slightly tracked-out sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for impact, with smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for buttons, image containers, and section edges, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with generous vertical separation between major sections, creating an airy feel, while content within grids is more tightly packed.

standout: The site's standout feature is its exceptional product photography, particularly in the hero section, which uses a flat-lay, editorial style to create an immediate sense of quality and artistry. This visual storytelling, combined with a bold red accent and clean typography, elevates the brand beyond a typical e-commerce site.
